messages:
tom: FYI PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/21456|PR #21456> (model-allocator) is ready aside from a flaky mac e2e. I'd like to land before the DB migration blackout tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Can we get a short merge slot or should we wait?
kevin: Heads-up — canary for the DB migration is 09:00-09:30, blackout 09:30-10:30. If CI is flaky we shouldn't merge during canary itself.
tom: tests pass locally; integration matrix shows mac-e2e timeout on the last run.
ci-bot: integration/matrix: mac-e2e failed (timeout). Rerun available: `/ci rerun 21456`
aj: I can kick a rerun at 08:45 UTC tomorrow (30m before canary). Ping me ~15m before and I'll queue it.
maria: If rerun goes green, I'm +1 for landing canary-only (feature flag OFF). I'll prepare rollback steps and a post-merge checklist.
olivia: Reviewed — minor nit in README, otherwise looks good. Approve after rebase+nit fix.
tom: pushed the rebase and fixed the README nit (force-pushed). Marking PR as ready.
ci-bot: integration/matrix: all checks passed ✅ (mac-e2e flake resolved).
kevin: SRE note: seq-queue is trending ~82% capacity heading into the window. Prefer to merge after 09:00 if traffic stays low; otherwise postpone to avoid queue pressure.
sre-sarah: confirming queue trend — I'll monitor and can throttle if spikes. If we see >90% we'll hold.
deploy-bot: scheduled blackout: 2026-03-19T09:30:00Z - 2026-03-19T10:30:00Z (DB migration).
aj: Reran CI now and it's green. I'm available to merge at 09:05 UTC if we want to land short of the blackout.
tom: Proposal: merge at 09:05 as canary-only with the flag off to minimize blast radius.
maria: +1 for canary-only. I'll keep rollback steps ready and watch logs post-merge.
kevin: OK — I'll do the merge at 09:05 UTC and open a tiny follow-up PR to toggle the flag after migration if everything looks stable.
olivia: I'll run a quick post-merge smoke e2e once merged.
tom: Assigning post-merge followups: @maria rollback plan, @sre-sarah monitor seq-queue, @olivia post-smoke. Thanks all :shipit:
deploy-bot: merge executed: PR #21456 merged at 2026-03-19T09:05:00Z.
ci-bot: post-merge: quick smoke checks passed. No immediate regressions detected.
sre-sarah: monitoring — queue pegged briefly but within thresholds, dropping now. All good from infra side.
maria: closing rollback ticket, will re-open if we see anomalies in next 30m.
tom: great — closing the loop here. Thanks everyone!
